text:
ellie: Dropping RavenBio RFI + capability matrix for review. Buyer asked for an interoperability appendix and a short fedramp-readiness statement. Attached: raven_rfi_revA.pdf, raven_capmatrix_v3.csv, raven_security_qs.xlsx

matt: scanning. Two quick buyer asks: 1) network peering options and egress accounting; 2) sample SLA for a 2-week dedicated eval.

sana: For peering we can offer VPC peering (hosted) or a private deployment that sits in their subnet. Important to call out egress billing: outbound transforms + nat gateway charges are on the customer if peered into their account. I'll add a note to the matrix network row.

ellie: good. Also they want an interoperability rubric (how we score latency, accuracy, and throughput). I started a short scoring table in the capmatrix (tab "rubric"). Please sanity-check weights.

matt: POC timeline: propose 10 days total: 2d setup, 6d steady, 2d stress. If they want contractual 99.9% uptime for the window, recommend Dedicated reserved pool. I'll add a sample SLA paragraph to the draft.

sana: Security checklist: missing FedRAMP readiness note, KMS/HSM integration details, and an explicit statement on data egress controls. Also please fill Q30-Q36 in raven_security_qs.xlsx. If they want FedRAMP IL2/IL4 gap list, we should include an ask for their expected control set.

ellie: I'll add a short FedRAMP readiness summary and an explicit sentence: "No customer data is persisted in Redwood accounts during ingest; customer-managed S3 buckets are used for raw artifacts unless otherwise agreed."

lee-legal: I'll review liability and IP clauses. Two asks: 1) carve out for customer-supplied datasets (no IP claim), 2) add DPA + security appendix link. I'll upload redlines by 09:30 PT.

files-bot: Uploaded raven_rfi_revA.pdf (2.4MB), raven_capmatrix_v3.csv (52KB), raven_security_qs.xlsx (28KB)

matt: Pricing nuance: embeddings priced per 1k units; with their projected pattern the conservative row should assume 25% overhead for retries and spikes. I'll add raven_poc_pricing.csv with optimistic/conservative columns. Also note: quota bump lead time 48 hours for hosted bursts.

sana: If they require HSM in their cloud account, Private supports customer-managed HSM; on-prem HSM requires additional validation and adds ~3 weeks. Call that out in constraints.

ellie: SE signoff needed on the interoperability rubric and the perf harness. Matt  can you add a curl sample for their infra team?

matt: sure, adding small smoke test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-small","input":"clinical interoperability test"}'
```

lee-legal: Uploaded raven_legal_redlines.docx with DPA link and dataset carveout. Also tightened POC liability to direct damages only and clarified acceptance criteria.

sana: ProdSec quick pass done. I updated Q32 with KMS phrasing and added the FedRAMP gap request template. One more ask: add a line that we will not transfer EU customer data outside eu-west-1 without approval.

ellie: perfect. SE signoff on rubric and harness confirmed. Legal redlines in. ProdSec signoff done. I'll consolidate and send to Raven ops by 10:00 PT. cc @raven-ops (external) :rocket:

matt: uploaded raven_poc_pricing.csv and added conservative/optimistic forecasts.

files-bot: Uploaded raven_legal_redlines.docx (14KB), raven_poc_pricing.csv (6KB)

ellie: all set  sending. Thanks everyone.
